```yaml
name: Deploy Website and Spec

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'website/**'
      - 'docs/spec/**'
      - '.github/workflows/deploy-website.yml'

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions/setup-rust@v2
        with:
          rust-version: stable
          components: rustfmt, clippy

      - name: Install mdbook
        run: |
          cargo install mdbook --locked --version 0.4.35

      - name: Install mdbook-spec preprocessor
        run: |
          cargo install --path docs/spec/mdbook-spec --locked

      - name: Build website
        run: |
          mdbook build website

      - name: Build spec
        run: |
          mdbook build docs/spec

      - name: Prepare public directory
        run: |
          mkdir -p public/website public/spec
          cp -r website/book/* public/website/
          cp -r docs/spec/book/* public/spec/

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          publish_dir: ./public
```
